== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Nova-Bots are a diverse array of robotic entities used for various combat, utility, and specialized roles. They are primarily characterized by their humanoid shapes, though they vary significantly in [[scale]]; some are as minute as flies or finger-sized swarms, while others are massive enough to carry fighters or serve as hulking armored units. While many models feature a signature single red eye, many others possess glowing purple eyes. They are constructed from skeletal frames that are rapidly layered with wiring, circuitry, and smooth armor. These machines serve many functions: they act as disposable shields in battle, pilot dark-metal bird-like spacecraft, and perform intricate tasks such as soldering metal or collecting biological samples. Specialized versions exist, including medical bots with white flared armor, drones with modified squat bodies and heavy cannons, and even tiny brass humanoids. Some Nova-Bots are controlled directly by pilots or technicians, while others operate via programmed instructions. In certain instances, they have been used to fill entire hallways or even exist as a fine dust. They are highly replaceable assets, often utilized in large numbers to protect living soldiers during conflict.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Associated with [[Doctor Nova]], these robots vary significantly in [[scale]] from tiny, hand-sized units to massive entities equipped with shoulder-mounted hologram projectors. While they are generally human-shaped with a variable number of limbs and single blazing eyes, their eye color can appear as purple light filling a room. These entities function as a legion that assembles one another, performing tasks such as stitching ships together, sweeping systems for debris, or acting as decoys. Depending on their configuration, they can be equipped with guns, used as a cloud of micro-bots to infect weapons, or reassigned for repairs. During various encounters, they have streamed into rooms with [[Starhammer]] and [[Leilari]], though [[Starhammer]] eventually blew them apart.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Nova-Bots are smooth, dark metal craft that possess bird-like shapes and are equipped with jetpacks. These reliable units, which can explode into molten metal, are printed by [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]]'s team and used for various tasks such as guarding halls or acting as doctors. During certain operations, [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] has utilized these robots alongside a robotic avatar, even using one as a glowing flashlight or having one hold a box. [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] can transfer data and components into a Nova-Bot, and has managed fifteen of these units that possess the ability to disable nearby ships.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Nova-Bots are silvery, humanoid androids characterized by glowing purple single eyes and the ability to transform their hands into lasers. These mass-produced pilots for [[Karoshan ships]] serve various roles, ranging from automated hangar crews and shipment loggers to specialists capable of cracking network encryption or collecting biological samples. Coordinated by [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]], who requires them to function and possesses a face partially composed of their metal frame, these units are maintained through the installation of data cores. After successfully seizing the [[Zenith Blade]], the entire army of Nova-Bots belonging to the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]] went missing, and the connection to them was eventually lost.}}
